description: Triangular solves (linalg/solve.rs), Givens rotations, the Householder axis and the multi-column LU / QR / Cholesky solves (WP 8.5-P14a)

format.tolerance_unit: raw units (1 ulp = 2^-32), applies to every output scalar

ops.name: solve2_lower
ops.doc: a.solve_lower_triangular(&b) (vector b; a SPD, only its triangle is read)
ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)

ops.name: solve2_upper

ops.tolerance: ceil(4 + 4 * A), A = max over outputs of sum over inputs of |d out / d in| (central differences)
